balls.text: another slower one, Harbhajan spots this one, he can hit them big, he does this time, launching the ball high over long-on for a six to finish off the innings, Mumbai end on 173, is that enough? CSK probably ahead at this stage
short of length ball outside off, guided down to third man for a single
short of length ball, Praveen wants to clobber this over midwicket, he totally misses it and that crashes into the top of middle, once again the Mohit slower ball does the trick
slower one from Mohit, back-of-the-hand, wobbly seam short of length, Harbhajan was winding up for a big hit, but he can only dab this towards cover
shortish ball, Praveen wants to club it to midwicket, sends it towards long-off instead

and another one, Mumbai imploding here, Rayudu charges out and looks to hammer the ball over cover, can only provide an overhead catch to David Hussey, but is it a no-ball, taking many replays to decide, the third umpire thinks there is something behind the line, tight call, but the ump believes Mohit's heel was behind the line when his toe landed

Aditya Tare hit a first-ball six that is the most famous shot of his career so far in his previous match, this time he gets a first-ball duck, a pitched-up ball is outside edged and it ends as a simple catch to extra cover
full ball on the stumps, drilled past the bowler, but Raina moves across from long-on to cut that off

got 'im! Nehra follows the batsman as Pollard backs away from leg stump, Pollard decides to go with the shot, ends up hitting it very high, Mohit Sharma at deep backward square leg continues CSK's trend of taking tough outfield catches today, this was in the air for ages, but Mohit judges it perfectly
a touch short, sits up ofr Pollard who hits it with brutal power to the square-leg boundary for four
hurls it wide outside off, Pollard had moved across to try get to that, doesn't get bat on it
Pollard may change that though, he's begun with a thunderous hit that is way into the crowd beyond midwicket
slower ball does the job for Mohit, Pollard checks his stroke, defends the ball towards cover for a single
short of length ball just outside off, guided towards short third man for a single
Mohit tests Pollard with a slower ball, swatted towards deep square leg
Rohit is gone, looks to hammer the ball but top edges it, the ball swirls towards short third man, Brendon McCullum makes sure he pouches that one
lofted extra cover drive from Rohit Sharma, steps down the track and makes width by moving away from leg, then launches the ball over the infield
short of length ball to start from Mohit, whipped towards deep square leg
length ball on the pads, eased towards mid-on for a single, just five off the over, superb from Jadeja
Rohit stays in the crease and taps the ball to square leg for a single
and they certainly won't mind this, Simmons going for another big one, but doesn't middle, a thick inside edge and the ball lands safely in the hands of long-on
another single, down to long-off this time, Chennai won't mind this
tries to make room but Jadeja doesn't give him much, slapped to long-on for a single
short of a length ball, flat and on middle stump, eased towards sweeper cover
Simmons makes this a good over for Mumbai, charges down the track and launches the ball over long-on, sweet strike that to finish the over
length ball outside off is eased past the bowler towards long-off for a single
short of length ball is eased towards backward point, Simmons set off for a single, but is sent back
another shot we have often seen from Rohit, skips down the track and flat bats that short of length ball over cover for four, powerfully struck
short of length ball on the pads, tucked towards midwicket for a single
short of length ball, well outside off, stylishly driven towards sweeper cover for a single
defended by Simmons to end the over
Faf makes it so easy as he stops that fierce lofted drive from Rohit, who skipped down the track before sending the ball towards wide long-off
length ball is driven off the front foot, Jadeja dives to his left to stop that one
full ball is driven towards deep point for a quick two
towards backward square leg for a single
no trouble at the start of the over this time for simmons, plants his front leg well forward and thumps that high and straight to the long-off boundary for six

how often does Rohit Sharma play this shot? seems like at least once every T20 innings, he's looking to drive the ball through the off, a length ball, an edge sends the ball wide of the keeper to the third man boundary, despite three dot balls to start, Mumbai have managed to get nine off the over
clipped towards deep midwicket
instead of trying to lash the ball through the off, Simmons decides to move across the stumps and helps this past short fine for four, gets to a quick half-century as well
short of length ball outside off, Simmons looks to hammer that through the off side, can't connect, that's six dots in a row!
connects properly this time, but doesn't place it properly, shortish ball is slapped towards backward point
short of length ball outside off, Simmons looks to chop that through point, but doesn't connect
three dot balls in a row to finish the over
guided towards backward point by Rohit
defended by Rohit to the leg side
well outside off, chopped towards deep backward point, Rohit sprints back for the third
Simmons flatbats this with immense power, there was a man at long-on, but Simmons was confident he could clear him, he does
Anderson is gone, a top-edge as he goes for the sweep, Ishwar Pandey gets under that deep backward square leg, has to wait a long time for the ball to land, he keeps his calm though and pouches it
drills this one towards wide long-on, Faf du Plessis is the fielder there, keeps them to a single
Anderson showing why he was the talk of the town before the auction, a scorching reverse-sweep here, gets serious power to send that ball behind backward point for four
there's the big hit, Anderson gets on one knee and slog-sweeps that over midwicket for six, just clears the rope, not sure how many other grounds that would have been a six
drops this short, Simmons pulls but can't get a boundary, just a single to midwicket
reverse-swept towards point for a single
short of length outside off from round the wicket, Anderson wants to shop that through the off, bottom edges it and it bounces towards the keeper
on the pads, worked away for a single to midwicket, Ashwin has bowled another tight over, just 17 off his three overs
a full ball is thumped towards long-off this time
length ball on the pads, Simmons stifled by Ashwin's outside-leg line, defends towards midwicket
on the pads, Anderson shuffles across and clips the ball to square leg
worked towards mid-on for a single
spins away as Simmons looks to thump that through the off side, misses

six second ball for Anderson, his national team captain, Brendon McCullum was luring at deep backward square leg boundary but Anderson has hit this well enough to clear the rope, McCullum jumps but he had no realistic chance of getting that
length ball is defended back towards the bowler
quicker one from Jadeja gets the breakthrough, doesn't bounce as much as Michael Hussey expects, Hussey was looking to slog that towards midwicket, the ball sneaks under his bat and onto the stumps
full toss outside off, uncharacteristically Hussey doesn't capitalise, he thumps the ball towards wide long-on, gets two for his efforts
steps down the track, eases the ball towards long-on for a single
short of length ball well outside off, slapped towards deep point for a single
driven towards cover by Simmons to end the over
full ball on the pads, was sliding down
tucks it away for a single this time
Hussey shows how it's done, who needs power to hit big? takes a couple of paces down the track and times it perfectly as he swings that towards cow corner
dropped short, Simmons wants to go big, his slog sweep can only send the ball towards deep square leg for a single
on the pads, whipped towards deep midwicket
full ball on the pads, eased towards wide mid-on, the bowler Jadeja has to chase after it, stops it just past the circle, the batsmen have sprinted back for two by then
just outside off, goes on the back foot, and clips that towards midwicket
full ball on middle and leg, driven inside-out towards long-off
clipped towards midwicket for a single
a reverse-lap shot from Hussey, can't get it fine towards third man though, it is towards point instead
goes for the sweep, towards fine leg for a single
on the back foot, looks to work the ball towards the leg side, doesn't get bat on it
thrashed towards long-on by Simmons
gives some width this time, slapped towards sweeper cover, where a diving stop from Mohit keeps the ball from reaching the rope, he's scraped his knee stopping that one
defended once more by Hussey
sliding in towards middle, defended by Hussey off the front foot
length ball is defended towards the bowler, Mumbai will be thrilled with this start, 53 in the Powerplay
goes to the slower ball which has worked for him so well in the past two seasons, doesn't fool Simmons though as he thrashes the ball through point for four
shot! Simmons stays in the crease this time, not that short from Mohit, it still seems to sit up for Simmons, who hammers that over midwicket for six
Simmons skips down the track and slaps that over extra cover, a flat-batted powerhit, he had the room to free his arms allowing him to get plenty of muscle behind that
short of length ball outside off, slapped towards deep point for a single
a classic Twenty20 hit, Hussey goes for the mow over midwicket, top edges it instead over the slips for four
guided towards backward point for another quick single
short of length ball on off stump, Simmons dabs it towards point for a single
on the pads, a length ball, can't get bat on it, the ball rolls off his pads behind square leg
angling across Hussey, who wanted to steer that down to third man but doesn't get bat on it
drops it short, Hussey waits for it and thumps it to midwicket for four more, two fours off the first two balls puts the pressure on Ishwar
a boundary to start the over, pitched up and that is punched over the bowler's head for four, Mumbai getting a move on now
stays in the crease and thumps this full ball towards mid-off, can't place it wide of the fielder
length ball is tapped towards mid-off
thick outside edge this time, the ball rolls towards cover
this time it is off the middle of the bat, superbly struck by Hussey, waits for it and slaps this past cover for four, it was a short of length ball just outside off, not too much wrong with that
Hussey charges down the track and looks to thrash the ball through the mid-off, doesn't connect
short of length ball on off stump, tapped in front of point for a single
short of length ball is worked away towards mid-on for one more
given a bit of width, that is helped towards fine leg for a single
another inside-edge, goes for a flashy drive through covers, but the ball rolls behind square leg instead
full ball on middle and leg, patted to the leg side for one more, that was a thick inside edge actually, sends the ball towards midwicket
137kph, pitched up, thick outside bounces through to slip, where David Hussey stops the ball
pitched up and on the stumps, eased towards mid-on
tapped towards cover for another single
short of length ball just outside off, defended behind point for a quick single, some hesitation there and if Jadeja had hit the stumps at the non-striker's end, Simmons would have been run out
gets on his toes and slashes that through the covers for four, stylishly done by Simmons
fuller ball on the pads, Hussey can't whip that away down the leg side, off the pads
more defence, this time to the leg side, Ishwar keeping it short of a length
defends Ishwar Pandey's first ball down the track
length ball on middle, blocked off the back foot to the off side
this one is down the leg side, should have been called a wide

misses out this time, Nehra is getting the ball to move around here, but now gets it down the leg side, should have been glanced to the fine-leg boundary, Simmons can't get bat on it, off the thigh pad
shuffles across and clips that to the midwicket boundary, great timing there, no effort to hit that hard
length ball on the pads, guided down to fine leg
the first ball from Nehra cuts back after pitching around off, Simmons is cramped up, he whips the ball towards  midwicket

all over, a bottom-handed flick through midwicket seals Chennai Super Kings' progress to the second qualifier. It was in the slot, Raina pulled his front leg out of the way and struck this far too powerfully for anyone to bother chasing
finds the yorker just outside off, Raina looked to guide it to third man but couldn't
this has too much height on it. Called a wide as it sails over Raina's head
shortish and he pulls towards midwicket
intended to be a yorker, but it ends up a full toss on off stump. Huss steers it to deep point
pushed down to long-off to retain strike
gloved. but it doesn't carry. A slower short ball, Huss wants to pull it fine but ends up almost ballooning it to the keeper.
that's his fifty. Raises his bat as he was running through for the single. This was back of a length and he punched it down the ground. Pollard tries to cut it off but misfields
goes wide of the crease and the angle allows Hussey to nudge if off his knees through square leg
stays back and pulls down to long-on. Didn't time it this time
corrects his line, but not his length. Raina knew it was going to be short as he went deep in his crease and pulls between long-on and midwicket
another one, this was considerably more shorter but still down the leg side. Raina went for a hook, but missed. Second bouncer, so a no-ball
bowls a tame short ball way down the leg side. Raina needn't worry about that
low full toss and he makes room and punches it back to the bowler
length ball and he clears the front leg and lofts down to long-on
full in length and he bashes that down to long-on
full outside the off stump and he drives him down to deep cover
this one lands on a yorker length and he gets an inside edge to fine leg, CSK getting close
fires that full outside the off stump he pushes it to the off side
over wide long-on for six more, this game is all but over
towards point for a single

length ball is launched over long-on for six more, this game will not be needing any final-over Dhoni heroics, three sixes from Hussey has more or less killed off this contest, especially with Bhajji's spell over
flat-batted towards mid-off, no run
drops it short, sits up for him, Hussey hammers that over wide long-on, he started slowly but he is 23 off 17
length ball is driven towards long-off for a single

an amazing hit from David Hussey! that was a full ball from Praveen, Hussey mananges to get under that somehow, and manages to find the power to send that over sweeper cover for six, top shot, 16 off the over, CSK in charge
full toss outside off, moves across and sweeps that, straight to square leg but still steals a single
a yorker on legstump from round the wicket, jammed out towards deep backward square leg for two more
full ball on the pads, squeezed out towards deep backward point, once again they take two to Bumrah, though this time the ball was well wide of him
short of length and outside off, glided down to third man, Raina sprints the first, a touch lazy from Bumrah, Raina pounces on the chance to take the second, Praveen is less than happy
Praveen's final over starts with a short of length ball that is inside-edged towards midwicket
short of length ball on leg stump, sits up to be hit, Raina hits it to deep midwicket for four, Anderson sprints across and though he covers a lots of ground, he has too much to do
a 136.8kph bouncer from Bimrah, Raina initially shapes to play a shot, but then decides against it
too wide from Bumrah, slower one, the first ball of the over had been a similar length, Hussey used the pace to put it away for four, this time he can only guide it towards deep point for a single
length ball heading for off once more, Hussey slugs that towards midwicket, sharp stop from Harbhajan there
angling in towards off stump, defended towards backward point
lovely shot from Hussey, that was short and outside off, steered away wide of third man and backward point for four
full ball just outside off, whipped towards deep square leg, Raina wants the second, Hussey doesn't
spinning away after pitching on off and middle, uppish off the edge towards cover, safe for Raina though
pokes the ball to midwicket for a single
well outside off, Raina wanted to late cut that towards third man, off the keeper's gloves towards short third
sort of length ball is thumped towards long-on for a single
flicked to midwicket
three dot balls to end the over, Hussey drives the final ball towards extra cover
more watchfulness from Hussey
defended to the leg side
launches this towards deep extra cover, Ben dunk has to motor across fron long-off, Dunk dives to get a hand on the ball and as he slides towards the rope, he lets the ball go, good bit of  fielding
turning across, driven towards cover for a single, the 100 comes up
short and wide outside off, should have been put away, Raina only stab it towards backward point where Praveen is struck on the forearm, seems to have hurt himself
Hussey is beaten by the last ball of the over, he ends up playing inside the line of the delivery as he looks to defend, extra bounce as well there for Harbhajan
driven towards long-on for a single
what a shot that is, Raina skips down the track and launches that over extra cover with the spin, a tough shot but not if you saw Raina execute it, clean hit with minimal effort
flighted length ball on off stump, defended to the off side
short of length ball, Raina puts that away towards cow corner, two men in the deep there though and he can't find the rope
quicker and just outside off, sliced off the back foot towards backward point
length ball is driven towards his brother Michael Hussey, 'yours Huss,' is the shout from the field
spins in towards Raina's body, Raina slaps this towards deep midwicket
D Hussey goes well back and guides the ball towards cover
McCullum's gone next ball though, charges down the track, the ball is short and spins away from him, McCullum is stranded yards outside, pretty embarrassing for the batsman to be undone like that

dropped, that is a tough chance, McCullum hits it off the bottom of the bat towards Ben Dunk at long-on, Dunk is unsure of exactly how far away from the rope he is, has to leap up to take that overhead chance and then balance himself, Pollard would have done it, Dunk can't, let's the ball through for six
Ojha starts from round the wicket, a touch short from him, slugged towards midwicket
spinning away outside off, Raina waits on the backfoot and slaps that towards deep backward poiint for a single
thick leading edge as he looks to work the ball to the leg side, the ball runs away towards cover
quicker one, defended by McCullum
McCullum springs down the track and clobbers that out of the park, a huge hit over long-off for six
defended to the leg side this time
huge appeal for a catch, Oxenford says that is not out, he's right this time, McCullum goes for the reverse sweep, off the arm
short and wide, slapped towards deep backward point for four, that was a poor delivery to end the over
wide down the leg side, Raina moved across looking to glance that but he misses
short of length ball on the pads, down towards short fine for one
short of length ball outside off, glided towards backward point, straight at the fielder

ouch! McCullum goes for the pull but that bounces more than McCullum expects, and the ball smashes flush onto the grille of the helmet, the startled McCullum nearly knocks over the bails as he completes the follow through of his stroke, think his helmet needs to be fixed as well
short ball at 134kph, pulled away towards deep square leg for a single
short of length ball outside off, guided down to third man for a single
on off stump from round the wicket, defended by Raina, and that over cost only four runs, there's spin in this track, Harbhajan and Ojha key here for Mumbai's chances, CSK still on top though
and another one, picks out the man at long-off, both openers are dismissed, Mumbai aren't out of this, Faf plays a lofted inside-out drive, not looking to really power it to clear the man in the deep
length ball from round the wicket, tapped towards deep point for a single
flighted and spinning in, towards short fine leg for a single
another one down the leg side
flighted once more, but it drifts down the leg side
flighted length ball, Smith wanted to slog that out of the park, he get it on the toe end of the bat, Pollard lying in wait at long-on, Smith's chancy innings is over
Harbhajan begins with a short of length ball outside off, defended down the track
low full toss as he tries for the yorker, squeezed to the backward point boundary for four more, that's the fourth four of the over, Chennai are running away with this
slower, 111kph, wide outside off, Smith wants to thump that to the leg side as well, reaches out and slugs it to midwicket
backs away from the stumps, Smith thumps that over point for four more, the runs coming quick here, it was back of a length and just outside off, Smith looking to hit everything here
this time the trademark Smith mow connects well, that means the ball is flying to the midwicket boundary
Smith living on the edge here, outside one this time, if there was slip, this was a sitter, there isn't one and he survives, once more smith was looking to work the ball towards the leg side
full ball from Bumrah to start, Smith is a bit surprised by that one, he is looking to nudge that off the pads to square leg, off the back of the bat to the off side
the ball moves in once more from Praveen, smith looks to drive, gets a thick inside-edge towards midwicket, Praveen grimaces in frustration
full ball well outside off, deflected towards backward point
short of length ball on off stump, clipped towards deep midwicket for a single
this one curves in towards middle and leg, Faf is cramped as he charges out, can't free his arms, he jabs the ball towards midwicket
too wide from Praveen but he gets away with it, slapped straight to cover point
pushed towards cover point for a single
four more, Anderson tries the slower one, it is dismissed towards cow corner for a boundary
no doubt about that one, slugged powerfully over square leg for six, way into the crowd, Chennai making strong start here

another half-chance, this should have been taken, a top edge towards deep square leg, Rayudu is coming in from the rope, Harbhajan is going back to take that skier, there is confusion between the two, neither makes an effort to take it, it lands between them, Rohit is less than impressed
short of length ball, Faf skips down the track and wants to launch that over mid-off, mistimes it and the ball flies agonisingly wide of a leaping Rohit
guides it down towards third man for a single
chopped towards point, Ben Dunk moves across from cover and dives to stop that one
full and on the stumps, to midwicket for a single
a low full toss is swatted away towards deep square leg, Anderson does well to cut that off at the rope

the worst decision of the IPL? Oxenford thinks that is going down, but there is no way that that is going to miss the stumps, a beautiful curving delivery comes in, beats Smith's bat and strikes his back leg dead in front, Praveen looks on in disbelief after his appeal is turned down, you can sympatise with him
outside off and moving away, taken by the keeper
this one goes away from the batsman, Smith dabs it towards cover and pinches a tight single
Praveen keeps smith guessing, a short of length ball nips in a long way, Smith responds with a slog across the line, doesn't connect
this time his swing isn't quite as well timed as Anderson dupes him with a slower ball pushed across him
wonder if that's why. This was dug in and as Faf was pushing forward. But still he was able to shift his balance well enough to pull behind square leg
fullish and just outside off, Faf pushes into the covers
tucks him up on middle and leg, with a tiny bit of shape into him. Smith works it towards midwicket
advances and he swings off his hips, the thick outside edge flies to third man.
dances down and lashes it through extra cover. Rohit runs to his left and dives, but lets it through his hands. He lands awkwardly on his left shoulder but all seems fine

dances down to negate the swing but the inward movement is just enough to foil his flick through midwicket. The ball wanders towards slip who sends in a throw at the keeper's end. The deflection gifts a run
it's the outswinger now and Faf is left groping outside off. Good length ball weaves away in the air and then moves away off the deck as well
full and speared into his pads, Smith wanted to whip it away behind square but doesn't succeed. Big appeal from the bowler, but that was always missing the stumps
miscues a drive on the up and finds mid-on
not this time. he's a littler shorter and the movement is considerably less. Smith steps forward and belts it through midwicket
what a ripper! This darted back off the seam and missed off stump by a whisker. Smith was rooted to the crease as he went for a cross-batted hoick through the leg side and is soundly beaten
